summary: Initial copy of 122 entries, 125 concepts, 13 subjects, 86 attributions, 66 review items and 822 initial assignments.
Agreed implementation revision. No entry was reclassified.
changes: concepte.csv: added maturitate:experiment, maturitate:pilot and maturitate:operational; replaced the maturitate:prototip definition. 125 -> 128 concepts. The table equals the frozen vocabulary of runs/2026-10-19-reasoned-evidence (LF line endings).
maturitate holds zero or one concept: a field rule with max_items=1; catalogue.json exports a string or null.

valori.csv: 16 named code lists, 65 codes, moved from the draft.1 schema.json enums and relation predicates, the validator's hardcoded lists, and the section labels of setari.json. No blank-code rows.
roluri-linkuri.csv and gazde-linkuri.csv: 22 link roles and 29 hosts, moved from setari.json without changing role IDs or host lookup.
schema.json: field_rules name a code list or concept scheme, with cardinality. Removed enums, relation_predicates and concept_fields.
setari.json: kept only the reporting addresses and a note. tabs.intrari is null until a v2 Sheet tab exists.
unchanged: intrari.csv, relatii.csv, revizuire.csv, atribuiri-initiale.csv, corespondente-v1.csv, mapari-externe.csv, arii.csv, source/, reference/, observatii/ and manifest.json.

amendments.change: valori.csv: added revizuire_stare:tehnic (65 -> 66 codes). A technical closure needs a reason and no editor decision; the publication gate counts only open items. No entry was reclassified.
